lines.zh: 沉重的脚步把草地震出一道道裂纹
lines.en: Its heavy steps split the grass with long cracks.

lines.zh: 它走几步就停一下，听地面的震动
lines.en: It walks a few steps, then pauses to feel the ground.

lines.zh: 护盾随步伐一晃，边缘刮过泥土
lines.en: Its shield sways with each step, scraping the dirt.

lines.zh: 每挪一步，身体里的震动就沉一分
lines.en: Each stride sinks a little more tremor into its body.

lines.zh: 它独自走，四周没有第二头
lines.en: It walks alone, with no second one anywhere near.

lines.zh: 甲片相互挤压，发出低沉的咔声
lines.en: Its plates grind together with a low clicking.

lines.zh: 路过的地方，石子被震得跳起来
lines.en: Where it passes, pebbles bounce off the ground.

lines.zh: 它的重量让木桥发出危险的呻吟
lines.en: Its weight makes the wooden bridge groan.

lines.zh: 一步落下，溅起半人高的土浪
lines.en: One step throws up a waist-high wave of dirt.

lines.zh: 它走得慢，但每一步都不偏
lines.en: It walks slowly, but never strays off course.

lines.zh: 护盾拖在身侧，摩擦地面的声音很长
lines.en: Shield dragging at its side, a long scraping sound.

lines.zh: 它顺着地脉的走向慢慢移动
lines.en: It moves slowly along the lay of the land.

lines.zh: 四蹄压下去，泥土像被压实了一层
lines.en: Its hooves press down, packing the soil flat.

lines.zh: 地面在它脚下轻轻发抖
lines.en: The ground trembles lightly beneath its feet.

lines.zh: 我一步踩下去，草根被压进土里。
lines.en: One step and the grass roots sink into soil.

lines.zh: 我走得很沉，护盾在身侧低鸣。
lines.en: I walk heavy; the shield hums at my side.

lines.zh: 它站着，甲缝里渗出细小的尘
lines.en: Standing still, fine dust seeps from its plate seams.

lines.zh: 护盾立起，把正面全部挡住了
lines.en: The shield comes up and covers its entire front.

lines.zh: 它在听远处的地动，一动不动
lines.en: It listens to distant tremors without moving.

lines.zh: 地面每隔一会就自己震一下
lines.en: The ground shivers on its own every so often.

lines.zh: 它仰起头，喉间滚过低沉的响声
lines.en: It lifts its head, a low rumble rolling in its throat.

lines.zh: 甲壳上有旧裂纹，像被撞过很多次
lines.en: Old cracks cross its plates, from many impacts.

lines.zh: 它把重量压在一侧，歇了很久
lines.en: It shifts its weight to one side and rests a while.

lines.zh: 地面里的震波从它脚下散开
lines.en: Tremors fan out from beneath its feet.

lines.zh: 它不动的时候更像一块隆起的地
lines.en: When still, it looks like a swell in the earth.

lines.zh: 护盾边缘沾着干掉的泥块
lines.en: Dried clods of mud cling to the shield's rim.

lines.zh: 它慢慢吐气，鼻孔里冲起尘土
lines.en: It exhales slowly, dust puffing from its nostrils.

lines.zh: 身上的甲片在阳光下泛着土色
lines.en: Its plates take on an earthy sheen in the sun.

lines.zh: 它侧耳贴向地面，听得很仔细
lines.en: It lowers an ear to the ground and listens closely.

lines.zh: 蓄着的劲还没散，四肢在轻轻发颤
lines.en: Stored force lingers, and its limbs quiver faintly.

lines.zh: 我脚下这片土，被我压实了。
lines.en: The soil under me is packed down.

lines.zh: 我等那股劲散去，再抬腿。
lines.en: I wait for the force to fade before lifting a leg.

lines.zh: 它抬起厚重的头，盾也一同转向
lines.en: It lifts its heavy head, and the shield turns with it.

lines.zh: 隔着护盾，它只露出半只眼
lines.en: Behind the shield, only half an eye shows.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，像在算你能扛几下
lines.en: It watches you, sizing up how much you can take.

lines.zh: 你靠近，它的护盾抬高了一寸
lines.en: As you near, its shield rises an inch.

lines.zh: 它上下打量你，重点落在你的武器
lines.en: It scans you, settling on your weapon.

lines.zh: 那双眼缓慢移动，瞳孔里映着地面
lines.en: Its eyes shift slowly, reflecting the ground.

lines.zh: 你没有危险，它便把盾放下了一点
lines.en: Deciding you are no threat, it lowers the shield a bit.

lines.zh: 它歪头，像不认识活的东西
lines.en: It tilts its head, as if it had never met anything alive.

lines.zh: 它看着你脚下的土，又看向你
lines.en: It looks at the dirt under you, then at you.

lines.zh: 盾沿轻轻磕地，像在提醒你离开
lines.en: Its shield taps the ground, a warning to leave.

lines.zh: 它注视你很久，地面一直微微震
lines.en: It stares a long while, and the ground keeps trembling.

lines.zh: 你举起剑，它整个身体绷紧了
lines.en: You raise your sword, and its whole body tenses.

lines.zh: 这一下被它的甲壳吞掉大半
lines.en: Most of the blow is swallowed by its shell.

lines.zh: 它纹丝不动，倒把力道记下了
lines.en: It does not move, but it records the force.

lines.zh: 甲片上多了一道浅白的痕
lines.en: A pale scratch is left on its plate.

lines.zh: 它低头看了看被打的地方
lines.en: It lowers its head to look at the struck spot.

lines.zh: 震动短促地抖了一下，随即平息
lines.en: The tremor jumps once, then goes flat.

lines.zh: 它把这股力压进了脚下的土
lines.en: It drives that force down into the soil.

lines.zh: 护盾微微偏移，又立刻回正
lines.en: The shield tilts slightly, then corrects itself.

lines.zh: 它闷声一哼，像是不太在意
lines.en: It grunts low, as if hardly bothered.

lines.zh: 挨了打，它的呼吸反而更慢
lines.en: Struck, its breathing actually slows further.

lines.zh: 你感觉手上的震感回传了一点
lines.en: You feel a little of the shock travel back.

lines.zh: 一束草递过去，它低头闻了很久
lines.en: You offer grass, and it lowers its head to sniff.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪过来，护盾稍稍偏开
lines.en: It shuffles closer and angles the shield aside.

lines.zh: 麦子刚放下，地面就震了一下
lines.en: The moment wheat is set down, the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 它对食物有兴趣，但先绕着走了半圈
lines.en: Interested, it still skirts a half circle first.

lines.zh: 草香让它放下了戒备，脚步也轻了
lines.en: The smell of grass eases it, and its steps go softer.

lines.zh: 它伸出厚舌，把草卷进嘴里
lines.en: A thick tongue curls out and rolls the grass in.

lines.zh: 你用干草引它，它一步一震地跟来
lines.en: Hay leads it on, one tremor per step.

lines.zh: 它吃得很慢，每口都停下来听
lines.en: It eats slowly, pausing to listen after each bite.

lines.zh: 苹果在它面前滚过，它低头去追
lines.en: An apple rolls past, and it lowers its head to follow.

lines.zh: 它吃到一半，忽然抬头看你
lines.en: Halfway through eating, it suddenly looks up at you.

lines.zh: 它把护盾靠在一边，好够到草
lines.en: It props the shield aside so it can reach the grass.

lines.zh: 一大捆草下去，它才愿意再靠近
lines.en: Only after a full bundle will it come closer.

lines.zh: 它对着枝条嚼得很认真
lines.en: It chews the twig with real concentration.

lines.zh: 食物让它安静下来，震感也弱了
lines.en: Food settles it, and the tremors grow weaker.

lines.zh: 我咬住草根，一扯就断了。
lines.en: I bite the grass roots and pull them free.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，我盯了很久。
lines.en: I have watched the grass in your hand a long while.

lines.zh: 你撞上它的护盾，自己被弹开
lines.en: You hit its shield and are thrown back.

lines.zh: 它整个身体一沉，把冲击卸进地里
lines.en: It sinks its whole body, bleeding the impact into soil.

lines.zh: 你被震得站不稳，它却纹丝没动
lines.en: You stumble from the shock, and it has not moved.

lines.zh: 盾沿磕在你身上，闷响传出很远
lines.en: The shield rim hits you, and the thud carries far.

lines.zh: 它侧身让路，地面随之一晃
lines.en: It turns to let you pass, and the ground sways.

lines.zh: 相撞的力道被它吞了进去
lines.en: The force of the collision is swallowed whole.

lines.zh: 它低头看看你，又慢慢挪开
lines.en: It looks down at you and slowly shifts aside.

lines.zh: 你的脚步被震波带偏了半步
lines.en: The tremor knocks your step half off course.

lines.zh: 甲片与护盾相碰，响得刺耳
lines.en: Plate clangs against shield, sharp and loud.

lines.zh: 它不动，等你先绕过去
lines.en: It does not move and waits for you to go around.

lines.zh: 两头相遇时，地面震了两下
lines.en: When two of them meet, the ground shakes twice.

lines.zh: 它们用护盾互相轻碰，像在打招呼
lines.en: They tap shields together, almost like a greeting.

lines.zh: 它把甲片贴上对方的甲片
lines.en: It presses its plates against the other's plates.

lines.zh: 两头一起走时，震感绕成一个圈
lines.en: Walking together, their tremors form a ring.

lines.zh: 它们并排站着，谁也不先动
lines.en: They stand side by side, and neither moves first.

lines.zh: 交配前它先清出一块平地
lines.en: Before mating it clears a patch of flat ground.

lines.zh: 低沉的鸣声一长一短，彼此应和
lines.en: Low rumbles answer each other, long and short.

lines.zh: 它们把护盾朝外，背靠背站着
lines.en: They face their shields outward, back to back.

lines.zh: 这一步很轻，几乎没有震感
lines.en: This step is light, almost without a tremor.

lines.zh: 分手时，两头各自走开很远
lines.en: When they part, each walks far from the other.

lines.zh: 东西掉在地上，它用盾推了推
lines.en: Something drops, and it nudges it with the shield.

lines.zh: 它没有手，只能用嘴试着叼起
lines.en: It has no hands and tries its mouth instead.

lines.zh: 掉落的物品被它踩进了土里
lines.en: The dropped item gets trampled into the soil.

lines.zh: 它低头看掉落物，没有捡的意思
lines.en: It looks down at the item with no intent to take it.

lines.zh: 一块石头滚来，被盾沿挡住
lines.en: A stone rolls in and stops at the shield's rim.

lines.zh: 它对地上的东西只是轻轻一拱
lines.en: It gives the thing on the ground a light nudge.

lines.zh: 食物它才在意，其他都推去一边
lines.en: Only food matters; everything else gets pushed aside.

lines.zh: 它把草叼走了，铁锭留在原地
lines.en: It takes the grass and leaves the iron ingot.

lines.zh: 它试着用鼻尖顶起那块木头
lines.en: It tries to lift the log with the tip of its snout.

lines.zh: 捡不起来，它就不再理会了
lines.en: Unable to pick it up, it simply loses interest.

lines.zh: 你砍了它一下，它缓缓转过头
lines.en: You strike it once, and it turns its head slowly.

lines.zh: 它的护盾抬起，正对着你
lines.en: Its shield comes up, squared at you.

lines.zh: 震动从它脚下传到你这边
lines.en: The tremor travels from its feet to yours.

lines.zh: 它先蓄力，四肢深深压进土里
lines.en: It charges up first, legs driving deep into the soil.

lines.zh: 它选定你了，甲片一块块绷紧
lines.en: It has chosen you, and its plates tighten one by one.

lines.zh: 那头巨兽不再让路
lines.en: The huge beast stops giving ground.

lines.zh: 它把盾放低，露出节省下来的力
lines.en: It lowers the shield, revealing force held in reserve.

lines.zh: 你退，它便往前压一步
lines.en: You back away, and it presses one step forward.

lines.zh: 地面开始持续地抖，目标是你
lines.en: The ground starts to shake steadily, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的护甲，像在找缝
lines.en: It stares at your armor as if hunting for a seam.

lines.zh: 它一步一震地跟上来，从不奔跑
lines.en: It follows with a tremor per step, never running.

lines.zh: 你跑得再远，震感仍在靠近
lines.en: However far you run, the tremors keep closing in.

lines.zh: 它把护盾举在身前，挡住你的箭
lines.en: It holds the shield ahead to block your arrows.

lines.zh: 它不绕路，直接把石头推开
lines.en: It does not detour; it simply shoves the rocks aside.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在你刚离开的位置
lines.en: Each step lands right where you just stood.

lines.zh: 你藏在树下，树开始剧烈摇晃
lines.en: You hide under a tree, and the tree starts shaking hard.

lines.zh: 它携着一路尘土，慢慢逼近
lines.en: Trailing dust, it closes the distance slowly.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸和地面的震动并在一起
lines.en: Its breathing merges with the shaking of the ground.

lines.zh: 你听见甲片摩擦声越来越清楚
lines.en: The grinding of its plates grows clearer.

lines.zh: 追到坡边，它停下来重新蓄力
lines.en: At the slope's edge it stops and charges up again.

lines.zh: 护盾砸下来，地面凹了一块
lines.en: The shield crashes down and dents the ground.

lines.zh: 它把蓄好的震动一次放出来
lines.en: It releases all the tremor it stored at once.

lines.zh: 冲击顺着地面爬上你的脚
lines.en: The shock climbs up through the ground to your feet.

lines.zh: 它撞开你，自己也退了两步
lines.en: It knocks you aside and steps back two paces.

lines.zh: 甲片边缘扫过，带起一阵土
lines.en: Its plate edge sweeps past, raising a cloud of dust.

lines.zh: 这一下不是打你，是打你脚下的地
lines.en: It is not striking you but the ground you stand on.

lines.zh: 它举盾再砸，力道比刚才更重
lines.en: It raises the shield again and hits harder.

lines.zh: 你被震得向后滑了半米
lines.en: The shock slides you half a meter back.

lines.zh: 它出一击就要缓一缓
lines.en: After each blow it needs a moment to recover.

lines.zh: 石头被震得跳起，砸在你身侧
lines.en: Stones bounce up and strike beside you.

lines.zh: 草地鼓起一个小包，然后塌了下去
lines.en: The grass swells into a mound, then sinks.

lines.zh: 一记闷震过后，它从土里站了起来
lines.en: After a heavy thud, it rises out of the soil.

lines.zh: 它只有一头，周围再没有别的
lines.en: It appears alone, with nothing else nearby.

lines.zh: 泥土翻起，护盾先露了出来
lines.en: The earth turns over, and the shield shows first.

lines.zh: 它站起来时，附近的树都晃了
lines.en: When it stands, the nearby trees sway.

lines.zh: 方圆几十步内，只有这一道震感
lines.en: For dozens of paces around, there is only one tremor.

lines.zh: 地面裂开一条线，它顺势起身
lines.en: A line splits the ground, and it rises along it.

lines.zh: 它抖落身上的土，站定在原地
lines.en: It shakes the dirt off and settles in place.

lines.zh: 第一声是地鸣，第二声才是它
lines.en: The first sound is the earth; the second is it.

lines.zh: 单只巨大的身影在尘土里慢慢清晰
lines.en: A single huge shape sharpens through the dust.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到甲片，它退开却不慌乱
lines.en: Flame licks its plates, and it retreats without panic.

lines.zh: 从高处落地的震波把它自己推开
lines.en: The shock of landing shoves even it aside.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，它的动作变得迟滞
lines.en: Water fills its plate seams, and it slows.

lines.zh: 爆炸的力被甲壳卸掉，只剩尘土
lines.en: The shell sheds the blast, leaving only dust.

lines.zh: 箭扎进甲缝，它抖了一下肩
lines.en: An arrow finds a seam, and its shoulder jerks.

lines.zh: 法术打在盾上，散成一片碎光
lines.en: The spell strikes the shield and scatters into sparks.

lines.zh: 草吃完了，它的甲片显得有些松
lines.en: With the grass gone, its plates hang a little loose.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，甲片导电般跳了一下
lines.en: Lightning falls, and its plates jump as if charged.

lines.zh: 失重的瞬间，它仍想抓住地面
lines.en: Even weightless, it still tries to grip the ground.
